Sandbox_PZGrok_RadioStation_tooltip: A new FM station every save. Falls back to a scripted library if the sidecar is down.
Sandbox_PZGrok_TelevisionStation_tooltip: A new TV station every save.
Sandbox_PZGrok_Survivors_tooltip: Hidden talk frequencies. Needs the Grok sidecar.
Sandbox_PZGrok_RandomizeCount_tooltip: On: rolls 1-15 groups per save and ignores the count below.
Sandbox_PZGrok_GroupCount_tooltip: Only used when randomize is off. Past 6, bands repeat.
Sandbox_PZGrok_OOC_tooltip: A listed frequency where you talk to Grok as Grok. Off by default.
Sandbox_PZGrok_TransmissionNoise_tooltip: Tiles of noise keying the mic makes. 0 disables.
Sandbox_PZGrok_TestRadio_tooltip: WalkieTalkie5 with every frequency already saved. For testing, never for playing.
Sandbox_PZGrok_UnknownVoices_tooltip: Label a survivor's lines with a voice description until their name is said on the air.
